items.title: A doubled color osp(m|2n) family with nonzero-degree Casimir elements
items.author: Naruhiko Aizawa; Ichi Fujii; Jambulingam Segar; Joris Van der Jeugt
items.source_version: Official SIGMA 22 (2026), 070; publisher native TeX retrieved 2026-10-13; arXiv:2604.08900
items.difficulty_reason: The author constructs an infinite matrix family of color orthosymplectic algebras, determines its graded commutants, gives a complete homogeneous basis and root decomposition, and computes two nondegenerate graded bilinear forms and explicit quadratic Casimirs. The general method alone does not supply this family-specific matrix, root and inverse-form calculation, all of which remain included. The commutant proposition is supporting work and is not a separate counted item.

primary.label: complete root structure, both invariant forms and explicit degree 00 and 11 Casimir formulas

proof_spans.label: complete doubled-osp construction, unique degree-11 commutant proof and full basis description

contexts.label: complete color Lie definitions and color trace
full general invariant-form and graded-Casimir construction
